items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you see him, Johnny Dunn? [INTERVIEWER] I saw him on the stage. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I used to listen to him ...(? )... There was another trumpet player back in those days, too -- Jabbo Smith. And there was one before Louis named Johnny Dunn, who I liked very much at the time. He used to the double-up time thing, you know, like the ...(? )... He'd do it with three majors and then double up the fourth one. [SINGS EXAMPLE] And it looked like every fourth chord he would just...he would double-time, you know. Playing notes that ...(? )... Solo.
Yeah, he did make a lot of records. He did things with the mutes, too.
